properties.name: Slice 3 ruled and planned: a requirement sent to another design arrives proposed with its origin and binds on the receiver's word
properties.rationale: Walked through on 2026-10-07 with the agent's recommendation and chosen as recommended. Binding-on-acceptance keeps check_intent_authority single-owner; where one person owns both designs it costs nothing. The 08-06 counter to option (A), that reflow2 cannot enforce file-only, is now answerable on a hosted design, where flo2.io authenticates every caller, but that is a flo2 permission change.
properties.subject: record
properties.summary: Anthony ruled the two open ideas slice 3 rested on: dec:idea-intent-crosses-designs ("Once accepted": a parent's requirement binds when the part's owner accepts it; copied with its origin) and dec:idea-gap-flows-to-the-dependency ("Write-only-at-proposed", one mechanism down to a part and across to a supplier). The requirement, capability (planned) and acceptance check (planned) are captured.
